note: Tyler County TX does not publish a county zoning layer; the county's DETCOG GIS Data subset (services1.arcgis.com/z3DZ2dwxv2tyH8pc/.../Tyler_County_GIS_Data) has no zoning layer. The only zoning source found is the Village of Woodville, whose zoning map is a PDF (2021) with no queryable service; other Tyler County cities (Chester, Colmesneil) show no zoning GIS.
